_meta.name: ios_design_tokens

target_device.note: Calibración: 1 iOS pt ≈ 1 Android dp (ambos ≈160 dpi lógicos). px = dp * 2.556

sources: https://www.apple.com/iphone/ (iPhone 18 page, redirects to iPhone main)
UIKit specs: UIBlurEffect materials, continuous corners, superellipse n=5
Frames extraídos de videos oficiales: ios-refs/frames/ (liquid_glass_oficial, dynamic_island_iphone18pro, lockscreen_animation, ios27_reframe, liquid_glass_vs_blurring)
changes_from_v1: spring: nuevos presets dynamic_island_expand/collapse, lockscreen_unlock, widget_transition
geometry: icon_corner_ratio 0.2237→0.2381 (iOS 27 squircle más pronunciado), dock_corner_radius 30→28, control_center module_corner 24→22, dynamic_island compact 232×34dp/17dp expanded 340×156dp/24dp
material: liquid_glass tint_alpha 0.08→0.12, frost_blur_dp 32→28→20 (C: 28dp medido; E: 20dp ajustado por PSS), specular_edge_intensity 0.10→0.14, shimmer_amplitude 0.012→0.018
material: UIBlurEffect systemMaterial blur_dp 42→38→20 (C: 38dp; E: 20dp ajustado por PSS), systemThickMaterial 56→50→30 (C: 50dp; E: 30dp ajustado por PSS)
curves: nuevo preset ios27_spring [0.32, 0.0, 0.48, 1.0] para transiciones fluidas
tipografía: weight 200 = thin (no ultra_light), tracking -0.015em labels, fallback FontFamily.Default + weight map
colores: paleta P3 extendida, tint base #0A1F2E (vs #142E3A), accent azul 007AFF→0066FF
dynamic_island: pill compacta 232×34dp (vs 36dp), corner 17dp (vs 18dp), expand stiffness 220→200, NUEVO collapse 0.75/280

spring.conversion: dampingRatio = damping / (2 * sqrt(stiffness * mass)); Compose stiffness = CA stiffness

page_swipe.note: cambio de página: críticamente amortizado, sin rebote

overlay_open.note: preset bouncy iOS 17 para módulos del Control Center

dynamic_island_collapse.note: iOS 27: cierre rápido con ligero overshoot

lockscreen_unlock.note: iOS 27: swipe-up unlock con rebote final sutil

grid.note: iOS 27: margin/gap 28pt (vs 27pt iOS 17), label gap 4pt, tracking -0.015em

dock.note: iOS 27: dock más compacto, corner 28dp, padding reducido

spotlight.note: iOS 27: panel más alto, esquinas 26dp, filas más compactas

control_center.note: iOS 27: módulos más redondeados (22dp), espaciado 12dp, controles más compactos

dynamic_island.note: iOS 27: pill compacta 232×34dp (2 semicírculos 17dp + rect central), expandida 340×156dp

lockscreen.note: iOS 27: reloj thin (200) 96sp tracking -0.02em, botones 52dp circulares

UIBlurEffect.note: iOS 27: blur radii base 28dp medido; E ajustado a 20/20/30dp por límite PSS (<65 MB)

liquid_glass.note: iOS 27: frost_blur 28dp medido (C); E ajustado a 20dp por límite PSS. Shared AGSL shader (singleton) Dock+CC.

typography.note: Fallback E: FontFamily.Default (Roboto) + weight map: 100→Thin, 200→Thin, 300→Light, 400→Normal, 500→Medium, 600→SemiBold, 700→Bold, 800→ExtraBold, 900→Black. Decisión final fuente OFL (Inter/Nunito/M Plus Rounded 1c) en F (rom-visual-spec).

gestures.note: iOS 27: umbrales reducidos, zona CC height 240px, unlock 180px
